_rules.note: PKHeX Encounters5BW.cs: 7 trades (Emolga, Rotom, Munchlax, Petilil / Cottonee, Basculin) with a fixed PID
_rules.plain: Pokémon from in-game trades are never shiny: their values are fixed.
Pokémon from the Entralink (Entree Forest) and the Dream World are never shiny.
